entities.summary: Sani Čampara is a Bosnian professional basketball player currently playing for Sloboda Tuzla of the Basketball Championship of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Standing at 1.90 m, he plays at the point guard position. He also represents the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team internationally.
